pages.title: The Shepherd
pages.text: Out of the light - only a shadow.

His hall is hearths and darkness. He puts out the fire, and in the dark he and his herd are deadlier. The lights on his shoulders are the herd - they go out as you thin it.$(br2)A hearth just put out smoulders a while and will not take at once.

pages.title: The pulse
pages.text: Whoever stands on the floor is deafened.
